### S8 full redesign, scoped: infrastructure + measurement + one conservative prune (not "full §8 landed")

`proposed` · `@jpegxl-rs.work.arch-s8-full-redesign-scoped/2` · part of `@jpegxl-rs.track.encoder-optimization/1`

Scope (not implement) the full outside-advice.md §8 surrogate-first
cover-selection redesign, per explicit user request, via two parallel
Explore scoping agents (architecture/machinery; safety/verification/
prerequisites) followed by an Opus advisor synthesis, each independently
checked against the actual code rather than accepted at face value.

Headline finding governing the whole plan: §8's core premise -- "avoid
forward-transforming losing candidates via cheap summaries" -- is mostly
foreclosed. Ranking a DCT16/DCT32 candidate needs coefficient-domain data
(a DCT32 spans 16 atoms; per-atom source mean/variance cannot recover its
spectrum), so a useful summary requires the forward DCT to already exist --
the forward is unavoidable. The achievable win shrinks to "skip the exact
per-cell choose/choose_lane4 scoring loop for losers after the transform
already ran."

Second finding: rate (residual_bits(q), discrete/non-smooth) cannot be
tightly bounded from a summary without approaching per-cell data, but a
loose PROVABLE bound exists (every guaranteed-nonzero cell costs >=2 bits)
and distortion CAN be tightly/exactly bounded for cells guaranteed to zero
(weighted_sse is a smooth quadratic, computable from coefficient magnitude
alone). So a provable -- not merely empirically-usually-right -- lower
bound is achievable, just looser than the existing exact partial-sum cutoff
in block_cost_bounded's `check`.

Third finding (Phase B, see note): CandidateForwardCache is keyed on
(transform, px, py) only -- forwards are probe-invariant by construction,
already getting 96-97% cross-probe reuse for free, and are the dominant
65-69% of cover-scoring cost. This forecloses §8's memory-saving half
entirely (discarding them to save memory would forfeit free reuse and
re-pay the dominant cost) independent of the cross-probe winner-churn
question Phase B also measured.

Given all three findings, the honest deliverable is infrastructure +
measurement + one conservative, provably-safe, WITHIN-PROBE-ONLY pruning
application that never touches the forward cache -- not "the full §8
redesign landed" and not the memory-saving design §8 originally proposed.
The aggressive closed-form rate-estimate half of §8 is explicitly staged
out (Phase F) pending a regret ceiling from real measurement -- attempting
it now repeats jpegxl-rs.work.arch-phase2-cfl-quant's failure (two reverted
closed-form-estimate regressions from 3 sufficient-statistics) at cover
selection's larger, more consequential decision surface.
